- FFmpeg is built without `--enable-gpl` and `--enable-nonfree` and linked dynamically (`FFmpegLGPL.framework`). You may replace that framework with your own build of FFmpeg.
- We do not own FFmpeg. Its authors are listed at https://ffmpeg.org/developer.html and in the source archive (`CREDITS`).
- The configure line used for every released binary is in `BUILD-INFO.txt`, shipped next to the binaries together with the exact source archive and any patches (currently none).
- The full text of the license is in the source archive (`COPYING.LGPLv2.1`).

- libass, FreeType, HarfBuzz, libunibreak and FriBidi are linked statically into one dynamic framework, `LibASS.framework`, which exports only libass's own `ass_*` functions. FriBidi is LGPL: you may replace `LibASS.framework` with your own build of these libraries (same exported `ass_*` API). The licence texts are inside the framework (`Resources/licenses/`).
- **FreeType credit (a condition of the FreeType License, so an app that ships this engine must show it, for example on its About screen):** "Portions of this software are copyright © 2026 The FreeType Project (www.freetype.org). All rights reserved."
- libass is copyright © 2006-2016 libass contributors (ISC). HarfBuzz is copyright © its authors (MIT, see `licenses/harfbuzz-MIT.txt`). Fonts attached to a video file are used to draw that file's subtitles only and are not copied anywhere.
- Test material that is generated by this repository: `Fixtures/src/BlockFont.ttf` (made by `scripts/make-block-font.py`), the picture subtitle files (`scripts/make-bitmap-subs.py`) and the effects script `Fixtures/src/fx.ass` are original and carry no third-party licence.

- dav1d is copyright © 2018-2025 VideoLAN and dav1d authors (BSD-2-Clause). It is linked statically into the *extended* variant of `FFmpegLGPL.framework` only; its licence text is inside that framework (`Resources/licenses/dav1d-BSD-2-Clause.txt`). The BSD notice must be reproduced by an app that ships the extended variant (for example on its licences screen).

Additional components will be listed here when they ship.
